title: control / control.heartbeat (v1) data payload
description: A 1 s liveness signal emitted by EVERY service. Like privacy.erased, it is a cross-cutting event: each service publishes it to its OWN '<service>.events' exchange (the `source` envelope field names the emitter) with routing key 'control.heartbeat'; the Control Room binds a wildcard and aggregates to detect DOWN (3 misses). The 'control' namespace reflects the catalog grouping, not the owning exchange. (Q&A Round 25; ADR-0004 bus-only health.)

service.description: Name of the emitting service, e.g. 'timing'. Equals the envelope `source`.

at.description: When the heartbeat was emitted. RFC3339 UTC, exactly 3-digit milliseconds, literal 'Z' (AR9). The pattern is enforced (format is annotation-only).

instanceId.description: Identifies the specific process/instance of the service (so the Control Room can distinguish replicas). Minted once at startup.
